description:
Score a site 0–100 on agent readiness: whether an AI assistant acting for a buyer can reach it, read what it sells and at what price, and find its machine interfaces.

Billing: free. Fetches ~10–14 URLs on the target site; takes 5–15 s. Cached 10 min per URL; 30 uncached checks per hour per host.

Checks: agent fetchers (ChatGPT-User, Claude-User, Perplexity-User) allowed in robots.txt; no CDN/WAF bot wall when fetched as ChatGPT-User; Product / SoftwareApplication / Service JSON-LD with an Offer price; prices in the pricing page's server-rendered HTML; an MCP server card at /.well-known; robots.txt Content-Signal; UCP/ACP checkout endpoints (stores only); A2A agent card.

Different from run_technical_audit (whether answer-engine crawlers may crawl the site, /llms.txt served). Run this for agentic commerce, 'can ChatGPT buy from us', or MCP / agent discoverability.

Stores: the site counts as a store when the homepage has Product JSON-LD, storefront markup (add-to-cart, Shopify / WooCommerce cart code) or a /cart link; store_reason says which. A store's Product markup is graded on a product page found through homepage links or the sitemap (or the product URL you pass as `domain`). When none is found, offer_schema is "na" instead of failing on the homepage. schema_urls_checked lists every URL whose JSON-LD was read.

Inputs:
  domain — hostname or URL, e.g. "example.com" (a product page URL is also graded for Product markup).

Output: { domain, score, grade, earned, possible, store, store_reason, product_url, pricing_url, schema_urls_checked, checks: [{ key, label, status: pass|partial|fail|na, earned, possible, why, detail, fix: { summary, code? } | null }], suggested_next, next_step, blocked?, not_checked? }. Failing checks carry a paste-ready fix. If bot protection refuses us (401/403/429/503): blocked: { http_status, as_agent_http_status, summary } plus not_checked. Relay blocked.summary as written; it doesn't show whether search crawlers get in, so don't call the site invisible to AI search from it.

domain.description: Hostname or URL of the site to check.

name: check_agent_readiness
title: Check whether AI agents can discover, read and buy from a site
